steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Obsessed with scavenging for treasures in Syndicate, OwO eventually ends up near the Rust. She suddenly spots several ominous shadows lurking in the distance.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh...? Are those... monsters? They'd make the perfect extras for my movie!

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Roar...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Owooo help...!

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: OwO gets chased by the uncooperative "extras" for several blocks. In her panic, she slips and falls to the ground with a "splat," losing consciousness immediately.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: While her consciousness is in a haze, OwO sees countless monsters clawing and roaring in the darkness. As she shudders in fright, a pair of gentle hands brushes away the hazy horrors.
There there, everything's fine now...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: OwO opens her eyes, discovering that there aren't any Corruptors chasing after her. Instead, she's lying in the warm embrace of a beautiful lady.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: She didn't know the lady, but perhaps because of how warm her hands are, OwO snuggles deeper into her embrace, rubbing her little face against the lady's comforting palms.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Owoo... There are monsters...
Don't be scared. The monsters are gone now. It's safe here.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The lady wipes away her cold sweat, and feels her forehead with concern.
Hmm, you should be fine now. Do you still feel pain or discomfort anywhere on your body?
If you feel unwell at all, make sure to let me know.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ohhh... Thank you, miss... I'm fine. I'm feeling much better!
Hmm... Do you know why you fainted, sweetie?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Fainted? Ahh... I must've been too tired! After all, I'm preparing to make an epic horror blockbuster!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I want to film the kind of haunted hospital that rattles in the wind. One filled with people-eating monsters wrapped in bloody bandages...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Oh right! There's also the crazy head nurse who tames others with her syringe! She's the main character!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So as a filmmaker, I just had to go deep into Syndicate to find the perfect cast and props!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sigh, if those Corruptors had cooperated and become my extras instead of chasing me... I would've shot some super cool scenes!

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: As OwO proudly boasts about her "feats," she doesn't notice the lady's face darkening.
Oh? You want those Corruptors to become your extras? Then... have you found someone to play the role of the head nurse?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Though the lady's tone is still gentle, OwO starts to feel cold sweat all over her body.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The lady gently strokes the back of OwO's neck. OwO's back becomes ice-cold, and her hairs stand on end.

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: Actually, I'm a head nurse myself. Do you think I'd be good as the main character in your horror film?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Meh...

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: Little kids shouldn't run around everywhere, especially in a dangerous place like Syndicate. It's not good for your own safety.

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: You were lucky this time. If those monsters had caught you... they would've done "this", then they would do "that" until they turn you into "this" too... Is that what you want?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: OwO looks at the smiling lady in front of her, and tears start streaming down her face.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Waaaaahhh... I don't want that... I won't do that again...

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: That's more like it. Will you do it again next time? Are you going to be a good kid?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I-I-I'll be a good kid! I swear I won't come to Syndicate alone ever again! Waaaaahhhh...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: OwO promises without a second thought as she clutches the head nurse's clothes and bawls her eyes out.

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: You're still young. As long as you grow up safe and sound, you'll get to eat all the yummy food and make all the movies you like. But if the Corruptors get you...

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: No no, I won't let anything bad happen to you. But you can't be naughty like this again, okay?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sob... I'm sorry, OwO won't do it again...

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: There, there... If you correct your mistakes, you're still a good kid. Shhh... It's all right. Just sleep on it and everything will be fine when you wake up.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Seeing OwO's earnest apology, the head nurse stops exuding her terrifying aura. She pats OwO gently on the back, softly coaxing her to sleep.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: As OwO sobs, she secretly lifts her gaze for a peek. She sees dark circles under the nurse's eyes, and immense fatigue from her expression. She doesn't seem to have rested well at all.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: OwO feels a pang of guilt. The head nurses in the movies are always very busy. She feels embarrassed that this nurse still has to look after her at such a late hour...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Miss, you must be tired too. Let's go to sleep together...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: OwO pulls over the blanket to cover the head nurse. The nurse freezes for a second, then smiles gently.

steps.speaker: Head Nurse
steps.content: Emm, sure.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The pair lies down on the warm, soft bed. OwO soon falls sound asleep to the head nurse's sweet fragrance.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Miss Nurse... Huh? Where's the nurse?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You finally woke up? Do you feel unwell at all?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: OwO wakes up to find that she's already sitting in the familiar van. Everything that happened last night seems to be just a strange dream.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You may not believe it, but last night... I dreamed of a beautiful lady! Oh right, she's also a head nurse! She's perfect to play the main character of my next film!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'll draw her for you, and you can start looking for actresses based on that drawing, okay?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sure sure sure, but drink this first.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What's this?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You may not believe it, but maybe the nurse in your dream asked me to make it for you? Drink up, drink up. Let's continue to find inspiration for your film.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sob... Why do I feel cold all of a sudden... I'll drink it, I'll drink it...
